player_prompt.intro:
Nwi uka Mwana {player_id} mu **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Tuma kambelo kwenu kama **[macro  micro]** (nambari mbili 0-8):
• *macro*  = ni mini-bodi ya kambelo
• *micro* = ni mraba ndani ya mini-bodi
Mfano `[7 8]` ➜ weka alama yenu mu mini-bodi 7, mraba 8, na
famula mpinzani wenu akambelo mu mini-bodi 8.

Nwi `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kambelo lazima iwe mu fomu [macro micro] na nambari 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Masharti lazima yawe kati ya 0 na 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: Mini-bodi, safu, au safu wima iko nje ya safu.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Mchezaji lazima acheze kwenye mbao ndogo inayofuata.

game_action.played: Mwana {player_id} akambelo mu mini-bodi {macro_idx}, mraba {micro_idx} (safu {row}, safu wima {col}). Mwana {opponent_id} lazima sasa akambelo mu {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Mwana {player_id} ushinda Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
